target_bug_relation: The protected UI-state test opens the Radio sample page and reads the bounds of the response-region demo rows (ids 'cityHot0' and 'cityHot1'). On the pre-fix revision the Radio control is sized 20x20 so each hot row measures 19 px high; on the post-fix revision the Radio is sized 20x48 (widthValue/heightValue) and each hot row measures 45 px high, matching the reported fix that enlarges the row response region so row clicks select the option. The test asserts the measured hot-region height; no wall-clock assertions are used.
